analysis: Examined all supplied CI excerpts, release-cache metadata and patch against the canonical definition index and selected T-041 detail. The complete range map limits ci.yml changes to head lines 149–155: a blocking source-comparison check plus tests for comparison and weak-import checkers. provider-release-cache.yml adds scripts/check-provider-weak-imports.py to its trigger paths at head line 25. These additions aim to prevent compatibility crashes and refresh release caches when validation changes; no existing test gate, permission, credential control or production authorization/encryption/cache policy is removed in the visible changes. Surrounding runner routing, cache restore/save, artifact reporting and provider-gate logic were examined but are unchanged and are not reported as regressions. Relevant integration concerns are serving availability (A-018) and release/build integrity (A-017, T-054), not changes to T-041 cache confidentiality. The invoked checker/test implementations and release-build invocation are outside this batch: integration should verify scripts/check-date-comparisons.py, scripts/check-provider-weak-imports.py and scripts/provider-release-swift.sh for bounded execution, correct compatibility detection and fail-closed validation. Their absence limits coverage; workflow comments alone do not prove those controls work. No concrete security regression is established here.
